name: Observant
summary: +1 Int or Wis; proficiency (or Expertise) in Insight, Investigation or Perception, and Search as a Bonus Action.

benefits.name: Keen Observer
benefits.summary: Insight, Investigation or Perception: gain proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient.
benefits.text: Choose Insight, Investigation or Perception. If you aren't proficient in the chosen skill, you gain proficiency in it; if you already are, you gain Expertise in it instead.

benefits.name: Quick Search
benefits.summary: You can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.
benefits.text: You can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.
